_comment: Settings of the SynVoy web service. Copy, adjust, and point $SYNVOY_WEB_CONFIG at the copy. Every key is optional; the defaults are in synvoy_web/config.py. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_where: data_dir must be on a local disk (database, search folders, conda cache).
_pipeline: conda_base is the folder that contains etc/profile.d/conda.sh. The profile and nextflow_config decide how much memory and how many cores one search may use.
_http: The service listens on localhost; the reverse proxy in front adds TLS. With a proxy, trust_proxy must be true, or every visitor looks like the proxy and shares one set of limits.
_genomes: Genomes a visitor names that are not on the server are fetched from NCBI into genome_store_dir, which may grow to genome_store_gb (0 = nothing is fetched). When room is needed, the genomes used least in the last store_score_days days are removed. Fill part of it yourself first: `python -m synvoy_web library fetch --from-file genomes.txt --fill-to 50`.
_limits: What one visitor may ask for.
_running: One search at a time is the safe choice: a search uses all the cores it is given.
_operator: Shown in the footer, the imprint and the privacy page.
